name: Pyromancer Dragon's Edge keeps max and current mana steady (#13663)
contract: Dragon's Edge 300755 (Draconic level-10 passive, SpellFamilyName 30) grants Intellect equal to 100% of spell
critical strike rating via hidden aura 900755 (Dragon's Edge Crit to Intellect, SpellFamilyName 36, Aura 29
STAT_INTELLECT, BasePoints -1 + DieSides 1 = 0, DurationIndex 32 = 6000 ms). Three defects caused periodic
max-mana drops and silent current-mana loss: (1) AscensionPyromancerContracts::ApplyContracts returned early
for SpellFamilyName != 30 before its 900755 branch, so 900755 kept DurationIndex 32 (6000 ms) instead of
was not dummied, so every 5 s it recast 900755 at 0 Intellect, dropping max mana by 15 * CR_CRIT_SPELL and
clamping current mana down in Unit::SetMaxPower until the 500 ms Refresh restored it; (3) Refresh's
AuraEffect::ChangeAmount removed the full old Intellect before re-applying the new amount, transiently
clamping current mana whenever spell crit rating changed. With 200 spell crit rating (+3000 max mana at
15 mana/Intellect), 900755 must be permanent (-1), 300755 effect 1 must have amplitude 0, max and current
mana must stay intact past 6500 ms after Essence of Malygos 802120 fills mana above mana_base, and toggling
QA Test +100 All Crit Rating 10036 (200 -> 300 -> 200) must change max mana by +-1500 without losing mana.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
CONTROL: Dragon's Edge Intellect aura is absent before learning 300755
Base max mana before Dragon's Edge
Base current mana before Dragon's Edge
Learn Dragon's Edge (300755)
SETUP: Refresh applies 900755
SETUP: 900755 grants 200 Intellect matching 200 spell crit rating
DISCRIMINATING: 900755 has permanent duration (-1), not 6000 ms
DISCRIMINATING: 300755 effect 1 periodic trigger is dummied (amplitude 0)
SETUP: 200 Intellect raises max mana by 3000
Learn Essence of Malygos to fill mana into the Dragon's Edge bonus band
Cast Essence of Malygos on self
Let Essence of Malygos complete its 6 s duration
SETUP: Essence of Malygos has expired
Current mana once filled above mana_base
SETUP: Current mana is at least 2000 above the pre-Dragon's-Edge ceiling
Wait past legacy 5000 ms periodic trigger and 6000 ms expiry
DISCRIMINATING: 900755 remains active past 6500 ms
DISCRIMINATING: 900755 keeps 200 Intellect
DISCRIMINATING: Max mana stayed at mana_base + 3000
DISCRIMINATING: Current mana did not drop during the 6500 ms idle window
Current mana before dynamic crit rating increase
Max mana before dynamic crit rating increase
Apply QA Test +100 All Crit Rating (200 -> 300)
SETUP: Refresh updates 900755 to 300 Intellect
Max mana rises by 1500 from +100 Intellect
DISCRIMINATING: Gaining crit rating does not transiently clamp current mana
Remove QA Test +100 All Crit Rating (300 -> 200)
Refresh returns 900755 to 200 Intellect
Max mana returns exactly to max_before_buff
DISCRIMINATING: Losing crit rating does not clamp current mana below the new max mana
